declaration.reason: Owner-authorised coordinated shared-file protection cycle for src/App.jsx. This portal independently verifies the shared navigation-shell change while preserving its own authorization, data, workflow and governance boundaries.
declaration.expectedEffect: The shared application shell makes the complete Meeting Portal module set available to every identity with a Members or Employees register record, regardless of active status or selected authority. It does not change this portal's own data, workflows, permissions or role controls.
prohibitedChanges: Do not change another portal's internals.
Do not weaken authentication, signing, invitation, deletion or deployment controls.
Do not alter this portal's internal source, data model, business rules or role permissions.
Do not weaken authentication, signing, invitation, deletion, audit, retention or deployment controls.
Do not grant meeting-specific leadership, live-room admission, voting, quorum or Board-record authority through general portal navigation.
Do not modify another portal's internals or use this shared-file record as a substitute for its independent lock tests.
